William Blake (1757–1827).  The Poetical Works.  1908.

Selections from ‘Jerusalem’

[Jerusalem]

(
Jerusalem,
 f. 26.)
S
UCH
 Visions have appear’d to me,
As I my order’d course have run:
Jerusalem is nam’d Liberty
Among the Sons of Albion.
